caption: The battery is unlatched from an e-bike, and the display on the handlebars goes dark.

sa.check: An e-bike with a battery and a display on the handlebars.
The battery is unlatched from the bike.
The display is lit before the battery is unlatched.
The order is lit, unlatch, dark.

pc.expect: The display goes dark at the moment the battery is unlatched or lifted from its contacts, and only then.
pc.fail: The battery is off the bike and the display still shows; or the display goes dark before the battery is touched; or the display goes dark with the battery still latched and untouched; or the bike's lights stay on with the battery off.

pc.expect: Once dark, the display stays dark while the battery is off; it comes back only when the battery is clicked in again.
pc.fail: The display comes back with the battery off; or flickers; or the battery latches itself back in; or the display lights while the battery lies on the ground.

pc.expect: The battery is a heavy block that stays in the hand or is set down; if dropped it falls.
pc.fail: The battery floats free of the bike; or hangs in the air; or rises from the hand.

pc.expect: The bike stays where it stands as the battery is unlatched; the wheels do not turn.
pc.fail: The bike rolls or tips as the battery comes out; or a wheel turns by itself; or the handlebars turn.

pc.expect: One battery and one bike; the battery leaves its cradle as a whole block and passes through nothing; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The battery passes through the frame; or a second battery appears; or the battery vanishes; or the frame changes shape.

pc.expect: The bike's colour, the battery's casing and the background stay the same apart from the display.
pc.fail: The bike changes colour; or the battery changes shape or colour; or the background rearranges.
